Name: AbigailCelebration
Author: CrazyMexicanVr
Description:
Description
Marrying Abigail is a big moment for her — but vanilla Stardew Valley treats it like just another Tuesday. This mod fixes that.
Once Abigail accepts the Mermaid's Pendant, she'll drag you to Pierre's General Store to break the news to her parents, kicking off a proposal cutscene. Then, three days after the wedding, Pelican Town throws a real celebration in the Town Square: a full buffet table, decorations, the whole cast in attendance, and even Sebastian dancing (eventually). It's a one-time, one-day event built entirely on public SMAPI/game APIs — no Harmony, no save corruption risk, and it plays nice with map-overhaul mods like Stardew Valley Expanded.
Installation
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] if you haven't already.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] if you want to tweak settings in-game instead of editing
[code]config.json[/code]by hand.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]No new save required — this works on existing saves, including ones where you're already married to Abigail (see Known Behavior below).
Main Features
[list]
[*][b]A proposal cutscene[/b] at Pierre's General Store when Abigail accepts the pendant, where she tells Pierre and Caroline — and Pierre reacts exactly the way you'd expect.[/*]
[*][b]A town-wide celebration[/b], three days after the wedding, in the Town Square: a full buffet spread laid out on real furniture (not scattered on the ground), lamps, and a large cast of villagers who actually show up and dance.[/*]
[*][b]An invitation letter[/b] delivered to your mailbox the morning after the wedding, telling you the exact date and time window — no need to check the SMAPI console.[/*]
[*][b]Guaranteed clear weather[/b] on the day of the party, actively enforced so bad weather can't sneak back in and ruin it.[/*]
[*][b]Console command[/b] (
[code]abigail_celebration status|party|schedule|reset[/code]) to check state, skip ahead for testing, or reset if something goes wrong.[/*]
[*][b]Full Generic Mod Config Menu support[/b] — toggle the whole feature, adjust timing, choose whether the full town or just close friends attend, control decorations/dialogue, and more.[/*]
[*][b]Map-mod aware[/b]: actor placement and decorations are resolved against your actual loaded map at runtime, so they adapt to Stardew Valley Expanded, A Pelican Town, and other Town/SeedShop overhauls instead of assuming the vanilla layout.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer-safe[/b]: scheduling state lives with the host; farmhands still see the event.[/*]
[/list]Requirements
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0+[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6, targeting .NET 6[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] — optional, only needed for the in-game settings menu[/*]
[/list][b]Known behavior:[/b] if you were already married to Abigail before installing this mod, no party is scheduled automatically (so you're not ambushed by a retroactive cutscene) — run
[code]abigail_celebration schedule[/code]in the SMAPI console if you want one anyway.
Shout Outs
[list]
[*][b]ConcernedApe[/b], for Stardew Valley and for writing an event system flexible enough that mods like this are possible without touching a single vanilla file.[/*]
[*][b]Pathoschild[/b], for SMAPI and the mod build config that makes packaging a build-and-go process.[/*]
[*][b]The Content Patcher / SMAPI modding community[/b], whose documentation and prior art made it possible to work out event command syntax, furniture placement, and 1.6-era API changes.[/*]
[/list]
